description: This file defines the InstanceProfileProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides functionality to fetch AWS credentials from the EC2 instance metadata service, including handling token retrieval, endpoint resolution, retries, and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: InstanceProfileProvider
classes.description: Credential provider class that retrieves credentials from EC2 metadata service, handling token management, endpoint configuration, and retries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with configuration options such as timeout, profile, retries, endpoint, and others.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method to load instance profile credentials asynchronously, implementing the retrieval flow via promises.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the EC2 metadata service, managing headers and response processing.

methods.name: handleRetryableException
methods.description: Handles retry logic for transient exceptions during metadata requests.

methods.name: getExceptionStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts HTTP status code from exceptions, if available.

methods.name: createErrorMessage
methods.description: Creates standardized error messages for credential retrieval failures.

methods.name: decodeResult
methods.description: Decodes and validates the JSON response from the metadata service.

methods.name: shouldFallbackToIMDSv1
methods.description: Determines whether to fallback to IMDSv1 based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the endpoint URL for the metadata service based on configuration and defaults.

methods.name: getDefaultEndpoint
methods.description: Provides the default endpoint URL depending on endpoint mode (IPv4 or IPv6).

methods.name: resolveEndpointMode
methods.description: Resolves the endpoint mode (IPv4 or IPv6) from configuration.

methods.name: isValidEndpoint
methods.description: Validates whether a given URI is a valid endpoint, including loopback address checks for insecure schemes.
